summary: Backend-only iteration 4. 54/54 pytest cases pass against public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (50 regression + 4 new emergent-session tests). Verified /api/auth/emergent-session contract: empty session_id -> 400 'session_id required'; missing field -> 422 (Pydantic); invalid/bogus session_id 'invalid-abc-does-not-exist' -> 401 'Invalid or expired session' (upstream Emergent auth/v1/env/oauth/session-data rejects it). Happy path {token, user, is_new} not testable without a real Google session, as expected. Full regression suite still green: /api/auth/send-otp + /api/auth/verify-otp end-to-end (dev_otp path), /api/auth/me, PUT /api/profile (sets onboarded=true), /api/stats/me (points, live_attended, breakdown, rules), /api/community/info, /api/books (9 Brahmatheerth issues), /api/live/attend (idempotent + 404), /api/mood/monthly-stats (30-day series + totals), /api/diary CRUD + /api/diary/dates + /api/diary/{id}, meditations/mantra/rank/orders(MOCKED razorpay)/guru/QA/SOS/sleep/music/guruji-image migration. MOCKED: Razorpay verify auto-succeeds; SendGrid replaced by dev_otp when OTP_DEV_MODE=true.

minor.issue: Upstream network errors are collapsed to 502 with a generic message. Consider logging the upstream status body (currently only exception path logs). Also no rate-limiting on this endpoint — a bad actor could probe session_ids.
When Emergent returns 200 but the payload has no email, endpoint returns 400 'Google account did not return an email' — this is correct behaviour but very unlikely; harmless.
(Carried) File is now 1200+ lines; still past the 700-line guideline. Split into routers (auth, points, content, commerce, community).
(Carried) No unique compound index on {user_id, session_id} — race window on rapid double-tap.
(Carried) dev_otp is returned whenever SendGrid send fails, not strictly when OTP_DEV_MODE=true.
(Carried) international scope is functionally identical to national when all users default nationality='India'; N+1 aggregations.
(Carried) Pydantic v1 body.dict(); migrate to body.model_dump(exclude_none=True).

action_items: None blocking — Emergent auth endpoint contract is correct and stable. Optional: (1) log upstream Emergent status_code + body when != 200 to ease debugging real Google failures; (2) add basic per-IP rate-limit on /api/auth/emergent-session; (3) address carried-over items from iteration_3 (split server.py, add live_attend unique index, gate dev_otp on OTP_DEV_MODE strictly, migrate to Pydantic v2 model_dump).

Frontend testing was explicitly out of scope for this iteration. When it happens, add testID on the Google sign-in button + on the emergent-auth redirect handler screen, and verify the client posts {session_id} to /api/auth/emergent-session and stores the returned JWT for subsequent /api requests.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/auth/emergent-session implementation is clean: session_id validated, upstream reachable inside try/except -> 502, non-200 -> 401, missing email -> 400, user upsert by email with is_new flag, JWT signed with sub=user.id — matches iteration_3 verify-otp flow so the client can treat both auth paths identically.
Legacy /api/auth/send-otp and /api/auth/verify-otp still exist and pass — safe to keep as fallback but note they are unused by the new frontend per the review request.
server.py is 1200 lines. High priority to split before adding more auth providers.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py (new — 4 tests for /api/auth/emergent-session error paths and endpoint contract)
seed_data_creation: No manual seed. Backend seeds meditations, music, sleep_content, live_sessions, guru_messages, quotes, Q&A, books on startup. Test users created per-test with TEST_ prefix for isolation. Iteration4 tests do not create any users (only hit /api/auth/emergent-session with bad inputs — no DB writes on error paths).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL: /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. To test /api/auth/emergent-session happy path you need a real Emergent Google session_id (redirect user to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<app_url>, catch the ?session_id= query param on callback, POST it to /api/auth/emergent-session). Error paths already covered in test_iteration4.py. Legacy OTP flow still works; both flows return {token, user, is_new} in identical shape.
